subject: BrightPoint co-sell demo dry run — pick 2 candidate windows
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightpoint.com>
To: Rafael Mendez <rafael@redwood.com>; Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@brightpoint.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: BrightPoint / Redwood co-sell demo — can you propose dry-run windows?

Hi Rafael + team,

Thanks again for the intro last week. BrightPoint is ready to move to a customer-facing demo for the joint marketplace listing and SI integration. Before the public session we need a 60-minute dry run (internal + AWS rep + SI tech lead) to validate the runbook and slide handoff.

Must-haves for the dry run:
- AWS partner rep present (Liz is our contact)
- SI tech lead for the integration path (we'll bring Victor)
- Walk through runbook step-by-step and the marketplace listing checklist

Can you propose two candidate 60-minute windows over Wednesday/Thursday (Aug 23–24) in the morning Pacific or late afternoon CET? We are flexible but want at least two options so we can coordinate with AWS and the customer.

I've attached our one-pager and the runbook draft for context.

Attachments: BrightPoint_OnePager.pdf (1p), BP_Marketplace_Runbook_v1.docx (6p)

Quick ask: confirm who from Redwood will own the live failover step and the rollback note in Section 3.

Appreciate it —
Sanjay
Head of Integrations
BrightPoint Systems
From: Rafael Mendez <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightpoint.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPoint / Redwood co-sell demo — can you propose dry-run windows?

Thanks Sanjay — we can run this. Quick notes and two candidate windows: 

Candidate windows (60m):
1) Wed Aug 23, 09:00 - 10:00 PT / 18:00 - 19:00 CET
2) Thu Aug 24, 08:30 - 09:30 PT / 17:30 - 18:30 CET

Attendees we'll have from Redwood: Vanessa (partner host), Kimberly (solutions engineer), me (product runbook). Karthik — can you confirm if you want to lead the SLA/rollout section or have Kimberly own it?

Vanessa: please flag any calendar conflicts — we should lock one by EOD Tuesday so AWS can confirm.

We can own the live failover step (Section 3.2) and Kimberly will author the rollback note; we'll add explicit timing markers to the runbook so the customer rehearsal is tight.

I added the proposed windows below as a Google Meet placeholder (will send actual invite once we confirm final window).

Thanks,
Rafael Mendez
Sr. Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Liz Warren <liz@amazon.com>
To: Rafael Mendez <rafael@redwood.com>; Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightpoint.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPoint / Redwood co-sell demo — can you propose dry-run windows?

Hey all — AWS can join. The Aug 23 slot at 09:00 PT works for me but I'd like to move it 30 minutes earlier if possible (08:30 PT) to avoid a downstream conflict.

If Redwood can do 08:30–09:30 PT on Wed Aug 23, I’ll be on the call and will bring the marketplace checklist (attached). Otherwise Aug 24 (08:30 PT) is also a backup.

Attachment: aws-cosell-checklist.xlsx

Liz Warren
Partner SA, AWS Marketplace
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@brightpoint.com>
To: Rafael Mendez <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Liz Warren <liz@amazon.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ops@brightpoint.com
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPoint / Redwood co-sell demo — can you propose dry-run windows?

Perfect — 08:30–09:30 PT on Wed Aug 23 works for BrightPoint and Victor (SI).

Forwarding Rafael's note below for context. We'll expect the following final deliverables before the dry run:
- Final runbook PDF with timestamps (Redwood)
- Marketplace checklist (AWS)
- Pre-recorded 5-minute product intro (BrightPoint)

Can Redwood share the final runbook by EOD Monday Aug 22 and drop the calendar invite when ready (please include the Google Meet and the agenda).
